input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The BASE_URL used to build links in emails (password reset, rollup, scheduled export) falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever PUBLIC_URL isn't set in the environment, which is likely what's happening in production after the latest release. It should fall back to or always use the configured production URL (e.g. from config) instead of a localhost default, so reset links work for all users.

input.title: Fix password reset and other email links falling back to localhost
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" when the PUBLIC_URL environment variable isn't set, which is why password reset, rollup, and export emails link to localhost in production. Ensure PUBLIC_URL (or an equivalent configured production URL, e.g. from the config module) is reliably set in the deployment environment, and have BASE_URL read from that config rather than silently defaulting to localhost, or at least fail loudly if no production URL is configured instead of defaulting to localhost.
